Amid all the chaos and confusion, it becomes clear that death is lurking around every corner, including when Yuuma runs into his classmate Sumika. Before, she was one of the cutest girls in his class, but she's since undergone a terrible metamorphosis—into one of the game's horrifying monsters! (Source: Yen Press)
items.synopsis_es:
Yuuma Ashihara, estudiante de sexto grado, y su hermana gemela, Sawa, están jugando Actual Magic, un nuevo MMORPG de realidad virtual, cuando de repente comienza a fusionarse con el mundo real. En medio de todo el caos y la confusión, queda claro que la muerte acecha en cada esquina, incluso cuando Yuuma se encuentra con su compañera de clase Sumika. Antes, ella era una de las chicas más lindas de su clase, pero desde entonces ha sufrido una terrible metamorfosis: ¡se ha convertido en uno de los monstruos más horripilantes del juego!

(Fuente: Prensa del yen)

items.synopsis: Recap of the first seven episodes of Zom 100: Zombie ni Naru made ni Shitai 100 no Koto.

items.synopsis: A PV to commemorate the release of the Koutetsujou no Kabaneri: Mumei Ranman figure as part of the anime's 10th anniversary project.

items.synopsis: Recap episode aired between episodes 9 and 10.

items.title: Shishigari
items.synopsis: Deep in the northern mountains, there are people who have been living with the blessings of the mountains. A boy, who is coming of age, journeys into the mountains for his first hunt. The mountain is a world where life and death are divided by a paper-thin line. Sometimes, nature will show its fangs... (Source: Official Website)

items.title: Samurai Mac
items.synopsis: Commercial for the Samurai Mac burger in McDonald's Japan, as a collaboration with manga artist Tetsuo Hara.

items.title: Tengoku Daimakyou Manga PV
items.synopsis: A promotional video that was released on YouTube in commemoration of the publication of the manga's first volume.

items.title: Chikajou no Mamono
items.synopsis: A demon has emerged deep beneath Tokyo. The governor of Tokyo and his escort unit go to inspect, but are trapped underground. Surrounded by darkness, with nowhere to go, people lose their reason and become consumed by the demon. (Source: Xumo)

items.title: PUBG Mobile x Naruto: Shippuuden Collab
items.synopsis: Promotional video for an in-game collaboration between PUBG Mobile and Naruto: Shippuuden.

items.title: AOTU Shijie Reborn
items.synopsis: The Creator of Aotu World is a reckless God who created a universe full of inequality, but also gave the people a chance to change their destiny- Just participate in the "Aotu Tournament" and utilize the "Special Abilities" granted by the system. Pass rounds of cruel tests and strive for the ultimate victory! Now, the tournament, which has been suspended for 100 years, has been reopened. Our protagonist, King, decides to enter the tournament in order to change the fate of his planet, Dengru, and find his sister...

items.title: Surviving Romance PV
items.synopsis: A promotional video for Surviving Romance featuring Area Fumatori's song "Jaesaeng (feat. Syepias)."

items.title: Shi Ri Zhong Yan
items.synopsis: It tells the story of Qi Xia, who unexpectedly finds himself in an interview room. After passing the interview along with several others, he enters the desolate Land of the End, embarking on a grand adventure with ten-day game cycles. After multiple cycles, Qi Xia discovers that his story with the Land of the End may have begun long ago… (Source: Tencent, translated)

items.title: Kino Shield Anime CM
items.synopsis: A commercial for Kinoshita Kokin's Kino Shield, a coating that provides sustained antiviral and antibacterial effects simply by spraying it on buildings and rooms.

items.title: Feng Zhong Zhi Ta
items.synopsis: After the end of the world, trees, lakes and oceans are taken place by rampant sand storm as well as ferocious snow. Human beings and animals all disappeared. What’s still alive are the tribe of dreadful monsters and the piercing cold. The very last human being in the world is an old man, whose life is hanging loosely on top of the tower in the air built by him. During the day, he has to climb all the way down to a very far place in order to get a bucket of water that looks like mud, which is then filtered for drinking; while at night, the tower in the air is his lonely hidden place, in which he’s supposed to be safe from the attack of those ferocious monsters. But one day, the monsters climb up to the tower in the air and attacked him all of a sudden. The old man picks up his guns and shoots back to protect his life. At the moment when he losts all the weapons, the tower in the air collapses under the weight of the group of monsters. (Source: Official YouTube Channel)

items.title: Rui Rui Huoshan Da Taowang
items.synopsis: This short film is the prologue to "Real and His Friends," about the little monster Real's habitat where the active volcano is about to erupt and Real has to find a way to evacuate his familiar home. From being accustomed to earthquakes to wanting to take away all his beloved objects, Real experienced a painful struggle in her heart. Eventually, with his wisdom and hands, he transformed the cabin into a small boat and embarked on his own adventure at a critical juncture. In this poem-like clip, the simple and lovely Real not only brings us laughter, but also brings us the courage to choose and face new life and new environment. (Source: Official YouTube Channel)
